### The Word of the Cross
Author: Ligonier Ministries
Site: Ligonier Ministries
URL: https://learn.ligonier.org/devotionals/the-word-of-the-cross
Passage: 1 Corinthians 1:18
Points:
- Worldly prestige and polished rhetoric can sway intellects, but only the gospel can convert human hearts.
- True hope lies solely in Christ’s substitutionary atonement rescuing sinners from divine wrath and condemnation.
- A person's reception of the gospel reveals their spiritual state, dividing the perishing from the saved.
- Believers never outgrow their reliance on the cross for continuous sanctification and spiritual endurance.

### God’s Gift to You
Author: Sharon Jaynes
Site: Crosswalk.com
URL: https://www.crosswalk.com/devotionals/girlfriends/girlfriends-in-god-june-18-2012.html
Passage: 1 Corinthians 1:18
Points:
- While creation displays God's majesty, the cross remains the supreme revelation of His grace and mercy.
- The two simple wooden beams of the cross demonstrate the vastness of God's sacrificial love for humanity.
- Unbelievers often dismiss the crucified Christ as foolishness, yet believers recognize it as divine power.
- Reflecting regularly on Jesus' sacrifice anchors the believer's faith and inspires personal testimony.
